name: fix-kalide-rename-sweep-scope
body: source: kalide-rename AC 'a case-insensitive search of the source tree … finds no eypres, ey-present or EYPRES_'; inconsistency: the same requirement's negative checks need tests that mention eypres.yaml/EYPRES_, and the apg/ spec store keeps intentional legacy mentions, so the AC could never pass (feedback-1); resolution: scoped the sweep — excludes git history, vendored third-party code and apg/; allowed matches only in the negative-check tests proving the hard cut and, optionally, one short "formerly ey-present" line in README/INSTALL [with user, per reviewer feedback]
